title.zh: DOJ Creates 'Super Intelligence' Task Force to Guard Against AI Abuse
title.en: DOJ Creates 'Super Intelligence' Task Force to Guard Against AI Abuse

current_state.zh: The U.S. Department of Justice launched a Super Intelligence Task Force, led by Associate Attorney General Stanley Woodward and Associate Deputy Attorney General Stephen Weiss, to prosecute misuse of advanced AI by foreign actors, criminal organizations and fraudsters and to push AI companies toward stronger internal controls and risk reporting.
current_state.en: The U.S. Department of Justice launched a Super Intelligence Task Force, led by Associate Attorney General Stanley Woodward and Associate Deputy Attorney General Stephen Weiss, to prosecute misuse of advanced AI by foreign actors, criminal organizations and fraudsters and to push AI companies toward stronger internal controls and risk reporting.
